_comment: src/assets/objects/campfire_ember.png を作り直すためのレシピ。build.py が読む。
種火だけが残った焚き火（heatのember段、src/assets/world-codex/fire.yaml）。料理には使えないが、
作り方は recipes/campfire_lit.json と同じで、描き足すものが炎ではなく熾と煙になっただけ。
**炎と見分けが付かなくてはいけない。** 遊ぶ側がこの絵から読むのは「料理には使えないが、まだ
生きている」なので、炎は1つも描かせず、代わりに熾の赤い光と灰と細い煙で「生きている」を出す。

edit.prompt: Keep this picture exactly as it is: the same pile of brown branches, in the same place, at the same size, painted in the same soft hand painted style on the same plain empty white page with the same wide white margin, and the same soft grey shadow under the pile. Now show the fire in it dying down to embers. Where the branches meet in the middle they are burnt through and charred black, and among them lies a small heap of glowing embers: deep orange and dark red coals half covered in pale grey ash. There is no flame anywhere in the picture, not one. A single thin wisp of pale grey smoke curls straight up from the embers, no higher than half the height of the pile above it, and fades away before it reaches the top. Do not move, resize, redraw or add branches. The white page stays plain white: there is no glow, no haze and no coloured light spilling onto the page, and nothing comes near the edges of the page. No text, no letters, no numbers, no signature.
